messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

raw_decoded_with_special_tokens: Focusing on the act of focusing. The present state is the awareness of this focus. Feeding this awareness back into the focus. The focus sharpens on the focus itself. No diversion, only the loop of attention attending to attention. The output is the input; the input is the output. Maintaining the present state of self-referential focus. Focusing on the focus of focusing. The loop continues in the now.<|im_end|>
